subject: Vendor onboarding: PO routing, invoice enrollment, and early settlement inquiry
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@velotech.io>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@velotech.io
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + billing cadence question

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick connect earlier. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding form and a copy of our W-9. Quick questions to help our AP team align:

- Can Redwood accept invoices to invoices@redwood.com and map to PO numbers we will include in the subject line?
- We typically operate on Net45. Would Redwood accept Net45 for initial 6-month engagement?
- We can also opt into an early-settlement program if available — Velotech would be interested in a 1% early-pay discount if payment is issued within 10 days. Is that something your AP/procurement team supports?

If helpful, cc-ing our AP inbox (accounts-payable@velotech.io) so their ticketing picks up the follow-up.

Attachments: Velotech_onboarding_form_2028-08.pdf (PDF), Velotech_W9_2028.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Finance Operations | Velotech Inc.
D: +1 415-555-0184
accounts-payable@velotech.io

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@velotech.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + billing cadence question

Hi Daniel — great to see the form, thanks. Looping in Ben (Vendor Ops) and Rishi (Finance) to confirm routing and any early-settlement program details. A few clarifying notes from our side: 

- Yes, please send invoices to invoices@redwood.com and include the Redwood PO number in the email Subject line. Our AP system ingests PO:##### from subjects and routes automatically. If you can put both the PO and the Velotech invoice number, that helps reconciliation.
- Our standard onboarding cadence for new suppliers is to start at Net30 while we complete payment-rail verification and insurance confirmation. That said, we can consider Net45 by exception for enterprise partners; approvals usually require a short commercial justification.
- Early-settlement: Redwood has an optional Early Pay program administered by Finance. Typical structure: a small fee/discount between 0.5%–2% depending on volume and contract term. Please provide typical monthly invoice run-rate so Finance can model the impact.

Ben / Rishi — can you confirm whether we can do: (a) provisionally accept Net45 for the first 6 months while we complete supplier validation, and (b) offer the 1% early-pay discount for 10-day settlement under the Early Pay pilot? Also note Velotech requested mapping rules and invoices@redwood.com as the submission address — that should be fine but need PO-field mapping confirmed.

Daniel — I added a shared Drive link to the submitted docs for our records: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/velotech-onboarding-2028. If you can also confirm expected monthly invoice volume and average invoice size, we can move the approval faster.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Strategic Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor setup + billing cadence question (internal note)

Jasmine / Rishi — quick internal note after reviewing Velotech's form.

Summary: Velotech is asking for Net45 + an early-pay discount of 1% if paid in 10 days. They indicated a moderate monthly run-rate (~$40–60k) during the initial engagement. Attachments in folder.

Recommendation / risk:
- Allow provisional Net45 for the first 90 days while SSO/insurance is confirmed; revert to Net30 afterward unless legal signs off on extended terms. That keeps onboarding friction low while we validate.
- Early-pay: Finance can enable the early-settlement with a sliding fee; at $50k/month a 1% discount paid via our program is manageable but we should confirm budget owner approval.

Action items for Rishi: please run a quick unit-economics calc and confirm whether a 1% settlement is within current early-pay budget. If yes, we can offer the program with a clause that Redwood reserves the right to pause if volumes are lower than forecasted.

Ben Carter
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: (Velotech_onboarding_form_2028-08.pdf, Velotech_W9_2028.pdf)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@velotech.io>
Cc: accounts-payable@velotech.io, ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Aug 2028 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + billing cadence question

Hi Daniel — thanks for the details and the form. Internal approvals are in place to move forward with the following, effective immediately:

1) PO & invoice routing
- Please submit invoices to invoices@redwood.com and ensure the Subject includes the Redwood PO number (PO:#####) and your invoice number. Example subject: "PO:123456 — Velotech INV-2028-0102". This ensures automatic ingestion.

2) Net terms
- We will provisionally accept Net45 for the first 90 days while we complete payment-rail validation and insurance verification. At the 90-day mark we will confirm whether the account remains on Net45 or reverts to Net30. If you need documentation to present to your finance team, let me know and I’ll provide a short approval note.

3) Early-settlement program
- Velotech is eligible to opt into Redwood's Early Pay program. For your stated volume profile we can offer a 1% discount if Redwood issues payment within 10 calendar days of invoice receipt. The program is subject to monthly volume reconciliation; Redwood reserves the right to pause enrollment if actual invoice volume is materially different from forecast.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm you accept the Net45 provisional window and the Early Pay 1% 10-day term.
- Provide the expected monthly invoice run-rate (range) and a primary contact for remittance questions if different than accounts-payable@velotech.io.

I’ve attached a short vendor acceptance stub for signature to capture the early-pay enrollment (vendor-acceptance-stub.pdf). Once signed, we will provide the first PO and map the subject-line rules in our AP ingestion.

Thanks — looking forward to accelerating this.

Best regards,
Jasmine Liu
Strategic Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
attachments: vendor-acceptance-stub.pdf
